in_marathi.name: Ashika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ash' (meaning 'honey, nectar') and 'ika' (meaning 'one'). This name signifies love, compassion, and the nectar of life. In Hindu mythology, Ashika is the name of a goddess associated with love and fertility.
